rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０３０＿０１０If you go with me, you're gonna￥have it rough, y'know?
＊Eiji＊＠０３０＿０１１If you're fine with that,￥I'll tag along.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Eiji Depart　－
＊Eiji＊＠０３０＿０２８Never thought I'd actually￥get to go to Elan.＝＠０３０＿０２９My grades were lousy.￥I'd half given up, y'know?＝＠０３０＿０３０And now I get to go.￥To Elan, the place I always￥dreamed of...
＊Eiji＊＠０３１＿００１I feel awesome right now!＝＠０３１＿００２Thanks for picking me!＝＠０３１＿００３With the two of us together,￥we're unstoppable.＝＠０３１＿００４Let's go be heroes together!
＊Eiji＊＠０３１＿００５I feel awesome right now!＝＠０３１＿００６Going to Elan is great and all,￥but what matters most is that￥you picked me.＝＠０３１＿００７I bet the two of us can make it￥work, even out on Elan!
